controls.name: Dust
controls.doc: params[5]. (was Heavy) Blend distortion (0) <-> sub-octave fuzz (100, 2 octaves down). The ONLY knob that adds the octave; at 0 no octave is present. Knob 1, matching the real FX33's Heavy/Buzz/Saw/Thrust layout order. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Motor
controls.doc: params[6]. (was Buzz) Gain / distortion amount only -- never adds the octave. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Filt
controls.doc: params[7]. (was Saw) Tone: single high-shelf. 0 = dark, 50 = flat, 100 = bright. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Power
controls.doc: Output level. Raised from the original's default of 1 so the effect is audible when selected, matching the rest of this pack. Note this is a LEVEL, not a dry/wet crossfade -- Dustbox's blend is Dust, which fades between the distortion and the octave branch rather than against dry. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.
